scenes.text: The *$99 AI receptionist* for any service business

scenes.title: Who it's *for*
lines: Cleaners, plumbers, detailers, lawn care: anyone losing jobs to voicemail.
Rick Chorney's Echo Janitorial runs one. Fortune, March 28, 2026.

scenes.title: Option 1: *buy it*
lines: Jobber's AI Receptionist: $99 a month on top of a Jobber plan. It answers, books and texts back missed calls.
Up to 15 calls an hour, per Fortune. Check current plan prices at jobber.com.

scenes.title: Option 2: *build it*
lines: Grok Voice 3.0 at 8 cents a minute plus xAI's Voice Agent Builder.
200 minutes of calls a month is about $16 in API fees, plus a phone number for a few dollars.

scenes.title: The *script*
lines: Claude prompt: 'Write a receptionist script for a cleaning company: greet, ask service, size, date and phone, confirm, promise a callback within an hour.'
Give it your real prices and service area. Nothing else.

scenes.title: The *math*
lines: One saved $300 job a month pays for a year of the Jobber add-on.
Chorney's comparison: a human on phones is about $4,000 a month.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Run it on your own line for a week before customers hear it.
Tell callers it's an AI; some states require it. Sources: Fortune, Mar 28; xAI, Oct 14, 2026.
